name: Be Strong
overview: Scripture calls believers to be strong by placing their trust fully in the Lord rather than their own understanding, recognizing that God goes with them and will neither fail nor forsake them. True strength comes from the joy of the Lord and submission to Him, enabling believers to resist the enemy and stand boldly. This strength is not self-derived but is found in the power of God's might, encouraging courage and steadfastness in the face of fear and opposition.
